scope: Standalone player-owned save data and bounded battle economy receipts
writerAuthority: Existing ChampionshipPersistentSavePort through the standalone application

saveTiming.policy: Preserve existing manual Save and Save and Quit entry points
saveTiming.reason: There is no battle runtime snapshot/resume contract. Do not persist a paid but unresumable active attempt or invent refund/loss recovery.
saveTiming.durabilityBoundary: Only successfully written manual checkpoints survive reload or forced closure. Unsaved rewards and costs do not claim durability.

migration.fromV1: Validate the original top-level allowlist, preserve all existing player slices and the exact raisingHome serialized string/digest, then add an empty battleEconomy state and emit schemaVersion 2.
migration.forensicPayloads: REJECT recursively, including parsed raisingHome string

battleEconomy.identity: battle:<positive sequence>, scoped to the containing player save/session
battleEconomy.replayRule: An identity at or below settledThrough never debits or credits again. The latest identity returns its existing receipt. Older identities return already-finalized without unbounded receipt history.
battleEconomy.snapshotRule: Wallet and ledger are projected into the same envelope and written with one existing setItem operation. Any finalized ledger requires the shop wallet slice.
battleEconomy.walletAfterMeaning: Wallet immediately after this transaction; later purchases or other valid transactions may change the current wallet.
battleEconomy.resultGate: Only the full expected completed-round flag list can settle the active immutable match context. Empty or partial results cannot claim a win.
battleEconomy.abandonment: Preserves current prototype Leave behavior, closes identity and grants no reward/refund. This is not an original refund-rule verification.

arithmeticAuthority.reward: Existing resolveBattleReward and creditBattleReward pure functions
arithmeticAuthority.modeGate: Preserve mode 1 / match index 61 suppression and completed-round win gating

limits: Ledger sequence and retry protection are technical persistence safeguards, not a reconstruction of original internal save layout.
No original automatic save timing, battle resume, complete player roster or all-mode eligibility is claimed.
App must discard stale callbacks when a player session is replaced; a sequence identity is scoped to its containing session.
